name: bear-creek-taudem-fill-A
why: A 256 x 256 window of the USGS NED DEM over Bear Creek, Oregon (HUC 1707030407), with the filled elevation TauDEM 5.3.8 PitRemove produced for the same cells. TauDEM was written outside this project, so agreement with it is an external cross-implementation check of Priority-Flood conditioning and of the depression inventory built on it.
citation: Cybercastor (2023). TauDEM for Bear Creek [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8335853
cut: gdal_translate -of ENVI -srcwin 828 1946 256 256, on inputs/dem.tif and on intermediates/pitfill.tif
rowOrder: north-to-south: row 0 of z is the northern row of the window, as in the source raster. OpenLiDARViewer's row 0 is the southern row, so a reader reverses the rows before routing. Every row-major index in reference is over z as stored here.
cellMetresNote: The source grid is EPSG:4326 at 1/3 arc-second. These lengths approximate one cell at the centre of the window and are used only to state areas; no comparison here depends on distance.

reference.module: PitRemove, run by Riverscapes TauDEM 1.2.3 as: mpiexec -n 2 pitremove -z inputs/dem.tif -fel intermediates/pitfill.tif
reference.quantity: Filled elevation (fel) as Float32. Listed as [row-major index, fel] for every valid cell where fel is greater than z; every other valid cell has fel equal to z. NoData cells are null in z and NoData in fel.
